name: Witness to a Prosecution
description: Witness to a Prosecution is a Hong Kong television series produced by TVB. The original broadcast was on the TVB Jade network with 45-minute episodes airing five days a week from 20 December 1999 to 16 January 2000. The drama stars Bobby Au-yeung as the famous historical forensic medical expert Song Ci. Set during the Southern Song Dynasty of Mid-Imperial China, Witness to a Prosecution tells a fictionalised account of Chee's modest beginnings and the events leading to the creation of his book Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified, the world's earliest documentation of forensic science.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: SUNG CHI was born right after his mother had died. The villagers regard him as an unlucky person and give him the nickname, `coffin boy`. CHI has two good friends, named CHA SIU CHAN and SIK DAN. CHAN is born stupid and dumb. The stall owner, SUNG SING, and his wife always bully CHAN. CHAN`s wife, SUNG LING, also looks down upon CHAN. DAN always fails in the public examinations. The villagers always bully CHI. CHI is so dissatisfied that he quarrels with the village headman. Unexpectedly, the headman has suddenly died after a fight with CHI. Evidence shows that CHI and a thief, TONG SZE, have caused his death. The two are then sentenced to death. Meanwhile, CHI is being hit by thunder and died. His dead body is moved to a funeral parlour. The funeral parlour owner, MA KWAI, discovers that CHI is still alive. He tells CHI that the headman has been poisoned to death. Meanwhile, KWAI is very sick. CHI in turn saves his life……

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: DAN and CHAN pay respect to CHI`s dead body and discovers that he is still alive. They are very glad. KWAI finds out that the headman had died of tetanus. DAN reports the case to the new district governor, SUNG YIK. YIK and the cop, LIP YAN LUNG, find DAN and CHAN very suspicious. They follow DAN and CHAN and arrive at the funeral parlour. YIK and LUNG trust CHI. He thus takes CHI`s advice and carries a forensic check. YIK even tells SZE that he will re-investigate the case. CHI pretends as ghosts to scare the headman`s wife. LUNG`s daughter, LAP FUNG, nearly spoils CHI`s plan. The headman`s wife eventually agrees to carry out another forensic check. However, FUNG discloses CHI`s plot unintentionally. The villagers oppose strongly. YIK insists. However, the dead body has already been dissolved and cannot go through forensic check. CHI and SZE will be executed soon. FUNG knows that she has involved CHI into great trouble……

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: CHI knows that SZE is an orphan. He sympathizes with her and decides to marry her. The headman`s wife eventually agrees to carry out a forensic check a minute before the execution. CHI and SZE could then wash off the disgrace. CHI has lost his job. He thus always goes to the funeral parlour to help KWAI. KWAI finds out that CHI has the talent in forensic check. He thus teaches CHI forensic skills diligently. CHI and SZE compromise that they will keep their engagement in the prison a secret. SZE is being chased by the loan shark. She has no alternative and steal LING`s money. CHAN chases after her. SHING is elected to be the village headman. YIK also proves that CHI is the descendent of the SUNG`s family. CHI is thus entitled to have land and be employed as the worker in the funeral parlor. CHI thanks KWAI and wants KWAI to be his teacher.  CHAN misunderstands that SZE is his sister who has been separated from him for a long time……

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: SZE and LING quarrel. However, they pretend to cope with each other harmoniously on the surface. CHAN is glad. One day, the loan shark again bothers SZE. SZE shirks the responsibility to CHI. CHI sells his land to repay the debt for SZE. The rich merchant`s (LAM TAO) daughter, LAM CHOI TIP, is beautiful but arrogant. CHI is deeply attracted by her beauty. FUNG does not tell LUNG that she has been sacked. When YIK learned about the case, he helps FUNG. FUNG feels grateful for his help. CHI stops a plague from spreading in the village. The villagers like him after this incident. LING wants to have a baby and sees the fortune-teller. However, SZE always spoils her plan. TIP thinks that CHI is a gay man. She bets with her cousin, KWAN, that she could make CHI propose to marry her. TIP tries to seduce CHI. CHI thinks that TIP really likes him. When he learned that TIP does not like his profession, he immediately resigns……

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: TIP is being kidnapped and KWAN is killed. TAO thinks that CHI is the murderer. Fortunately, CHAN and DAN prove that CHI is with them during the murder. YIK orders CHI to resume duty and carry out a forensic check with KWAN`s body. CHI finds out that KWAN has died of sword wound. He suspects that it was the woodman`s deed. A masked man extorts thirty thousand tael from TAO with TIP as hostage. He even requests the servant, KUEN, to deliver the ransom. CHI eventually finds out that the murderer is a gallant in the martial world. The masked man kills KUEN and gets the ransom. He even intends to kill TIP. Fortunately, YIK saves TIP in time. LUNG urges FUNG to return to Chengzhou. FUNG is very reluctant to leave. YIK employs FUNG and helps her to get rid of the trouble. CHAN sighs that his family does not have any scholars. He thus forces SZE to study. SZE is lazy. YIK enlightens SZE. SZE decides to study hard.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: YIK discovers a thief at home. In fact, this thief is the real YIK. The false YIK`s real name is FONG CHUN. His family has gone bankrupt. He met YIK whose appearance assembles him and had fallen from a cliff. CHUN thinks that YIK has died. CHUN then disguises as YIK. However, YIK is still alive. CHUN and YIK quarrel with each other. CHUN kills YIK and buries his dead body near the well. DAN fails in the public examination for many times due to some psychological factor. They encourage DAN to take a mock examination. DAN`s performance is good in the mock examination. However, DAN fails again in the public examination. LING finds SZE very troublesome. She instigates CHAN to find a husband for SZE. CHAN finds CHI is suitable for SZE.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: SZE places the rabbit in CHI`s home temporarily. When CHAN comes to propose a marriage between CHI and SZE. CHI thinks that it is regarding the rabbit. CHI agrees. CHI investigates KWAN`s case further. He suspects FOK. However, FOK has already been killed. CHI goes to LAM`s home to investigate KWAN`s case again. Fortunately, FUNG bursts into FOK`s home. CHI could then escape from being killed by the masked man. TIP bullies the temple worker and his family. YIK cannot tolerate and keeps her into the prison. SZE has blossomed love feeling on YIK when he is teaching her. CHI teases SZE. A tiger killed some villagers. All are alerted. The wine-house owner, KONG CHI YEUNG kills the tiger.  CHI carries out a forensic check with the dead tiger and discovers that the tiger has died of serious breakage of its internal organs.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: CHI and the others suspect that YEUNG is good at marital art and he might be related to KWAN`s murder case. They then focus on investigating YEUNG and CHING. However, they have no clue at all. FUNG devises to trap YEUNG. Unexpectedly, the one they caught was CHING. YEUNG disguises as another person and leaves the town. CHING is glad to learn that YEUNG has escaped. FUNG tries to convince CHING to confess but is in vain. YEUNG tries to help CHING escape from prison by all means. He aims only at getting back the ransom. CHING is very disappointed. FUNG eventually kills YEUNG. FUNG and the others speak good words for CHING so as to help her exonerate from punishment. SZE perks up herself on the festival. CHI is very impressed. A female victim who had been raped before she was murdered. CHI discovers that some glue in her mouth. YIK tells SZE that he got no time to teach her anymore. SZE is very disappointed. CHI witnesses the scene.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: SZE intends to express her love to YIK. However, she is very disappointed when she finds out that YIK and FUNG has fallen in love. CHI thinks that YIK has refused SZE in person, CHI blames YIK. Murder and rape cases happen incessantly. They eventually identify a suspect, KWAI. The evidence left matches with KWAI`s. When YIK is going to execute KWAI, KWAI tells them that he had been sterilized and is impotent. CHI discovers that the murderer has six fingers. They suspect FU who is very afraid of his wife. However, LUNG thinks that he is not the murderer. SZE has a strong sense of righteous. FU finds her very similar to his wife. FU intends to kill SZE. Fortunately, LUNG and FUNG arrive in time and save SZE. Since then FUNG and SZE become good friend.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: CHI concerns SZE a lot but SZE does not thank him at all. SHING and his wife set up a shop selling rice. They convince CHAN to help them manage the rice shop. TIP falls into a pond. YIK saves TIP. TIP admires YIK. One day, a eunuch, CHOI, passes by. He recognizes KWAI is an ex-eunuch, SIU HING CHI. KWAI keeps away from CHOI. CHI finds KWAI very suspicious and questions him. KWAI then tells CHI CHOI's bad deeds. KWAI secludes in a small town so as to keep away from CHOI and his persecution. CHI encourages KWAI to report the case to the governor but is stopped by YIK. KWAI agrees with YIK. CHI is very influential in the palace. TAO tries to flatter CHOI. YIK also wants to win CHOI`s favour. YIK knows that TIP likes him. He then starts to court TIP. A group of small children are playing in a forest. They discover KWAI who had committed suicide by hanging oneself in the forest. CHI strongly believes that KWAI`s case was not a suicide case.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: CHI is very upset because of KWAI`s death. He disappears for three days. CHOI rewards YIK who has found KWAI and bestows him a gold plate for exclusive use. CHAN and DAN ask YAN to console CHI. SZE also comforts CHI. All stay in the funeral so as to get some clue. CHI eventually finds out some evidence. However, YIK does not want to offend CHOI and stops CHI to carry out any further investigation. SZE encourages CHI to sue CHOI at the capital. SZE and CHI then set off to the capital. Prince CHIU YUEN CHOI plays tricks on CHI and SZE for a few times. CHIU helps CHI and SZE to slip into the palace for apology. CHI and SZE disguise as eunuch and palace servant respectively. They wait for a chance to see the Emperor and tell him the case.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: One day, CHI saves CHOI. CHOI then appreciates CHI. CHOI and the concubine, WING, have an affair. WING knows that CHOI likes SZE. She then arranges CHOI to have SZE. Fortunately, CHI saves SZE in time. YIK and FUNG go to the capital to find CHI. FUNG tells YIK that CHI has already gone into the palace. YIK then informs CHOI. CHOI sues CHI before CHI took action. WING is pregnant. CHOI poisons WING to death. CHI persuades CHIU to help them in finding evidence against CHOI. They even use SZE as entice. The Emperor then sentences CHOI to death. SZE returns home and finds out that CHAN spent all his money for the sake of knowing whether SZE is safe. SZE feels very sorry. TIP tells YIK that he Emperor is going to reward him. However, the Emperor rewards CHI instead. YIK is very disappointed. A lady comes to ask for help. YIK intends to ask what has happened……

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: YIK was teased by the public regarding how he handles the navigation problem. TIP makes use of her family's wealth to help YIK. YIK has an appointment with FUNG. On the way he meets TIP. YIK and TIP have an affair. SZE decides to tell CHAN that she is not his flesh and blood sister and decides to move back to her old home. SZE`s house is on fire. CHAN risks his life to save her. SZE is very touched. When YIK is going to meet FUNG. TIP makes YIK to go out with her. They again have an affair. FUNG sees that YIK did not show up. FUNG thinks that she has made a mistake and went to the wrong meeting place. She even apologizes to YIK. SZE sees YIK and TIP who are together. SZE tells FUNG the case. FUNG questions YIK. YIK frankly tells FUNG that he is going to marry TIP. SHING and FA covet for wealth and supports YIK and TIP`s marriage. FUNG lies to LUNG the truth in lest he will worry for her.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: An unidentified skeleton was found in town. CHI invents a new method of forensic check by painting ink on top of the bone. SZE records all the procedures. TIP is born unreasonable and arrogant. Though FA and SHING are very dissatisfied with her, they have to tolerate her. FUNG tells SZE that CHI loves SZE. SZE wants to test CHI and claims that she has lost a jade given by her mom. CHI searches everywhere for SZE. SZE is vexed and returns to her old home. CHI goes to her old home to see SZE and finds a parcel in the wall. This parcel could prove SZE`s identity. SZE is, indeed, Prince HONG`s daughter. Encouraged by CHI and FUNG, SZE decides to go to see Prince HONG. CHI makes excuse to accompany SZE and CHAN to HONG`s place. SZE feels very sweet at heart. On the way SZE meets her sister, SUM YU. YU thinks that SZE is a thief. There is a hanging dead body in the inn. CHI volunteers to carry out a forensic check.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: With CHI`s help, the cops could easily arrest the murderer. SZE arrives HONG`s place and finds out that HONG has already died. HONG`s concubine promises SZE that they would restore her princess status. She asks her to go back home first and wait for their arrangement. TIP is still very arrogant and rude after marrying YIK. She even wants SHING to reserve some space for her to keep her clothing in the kitchen. YIK relies on TIP`s family financially, hence, they have to tolerate her. LUNG starts to like CHING. However, he does not tell CHING his feeling in lest he will lose face. FA finds TIP spends extravagantly. FA sells TIP`s clothing to earn money. When TIP finds out the case, she threatens to sue FA. In order not to involve YIK into trouble, FA apologizes to TIP. SZE waits for a long time and receives no reply from HONG`s concubine. She takes SZE`s evidence and drives SZE away. SZE meets YU who is her sister……

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: CHI risks his life to go to the tomb to find CHUNG. However, HONG`s concubine stops CHI. She intends to kill SZE and CHI. Fortunately, YU saves them in time. YU brings SZE her parcel. On the way a rascal kidnaps SZE. The rascal intends to sell SZE to the brothel. DAN eavesdrops the rascal`s conversation. DAN then saves SZE but he destroys SZE`s parcel simultaneously. CHI thinks of having a blood test to prove SZE`s identity. HONG`s concubine opposes the test. CHIU guarantees his life to take the test. They eventually prove that SZE is HONG`s flesh and blood daughter. SZE gives a jade rabbit to CHI as an engagement souvenir. The debtors asks TIP`s family to repay the debt. TIP then has not enough money to buy a governor post for YIK. She is very angry with her parents. CHI is promoted to be the chief prison in charge. CHI heard that SZE is going to marry a Mongolian Prince……

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: YIK always speaks sweet words. He made CHI trusts him and confirms that he is not the one who betrayed him. CHI is very sick. His life is at stake. Fortunately, FUNG discovers a new treatment that saves CHI`s life. YU tells SZE about her assigned marriage with a Mongolian Prince. SZE asks the Emperor to stop it. TIP makes use YIK`s governing chop to shop. YIK and SZE quarrel. SHING instigates the quarrel. TIP drinks to forget her trouble. CHI comforts her. LUNG does not dare to tell CHING his love. With CHI and FUNG`s help, LUNG and CHING start to go out. YIK treats TIP coldly. TIP tells CHI her grievance. CHI encourages TIP to live anew. TIP decides to be a good wife with CHI`s encouragement. FA sees TIP and CHI while they are talking with each other.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: YIK listens to FA`s words and believes that CHI and TIP do have an affair. TIP and YIK quarrel with each other. SZE is very upset to see FUNG and CHI so intimate. YIK is the one in charge of building SZE`s mother`s tomb. YIK meets SZE and is deeply attracted by her who is now so beautiful. TIP heard that her parents are arrested. She asks YIK to rescue them but YIK refuses TIP. The patron of the real YIK, HO, visits YIK`s home. HO makes FA suspects the false YIK. FA steals YIK`s document so as to examine his handwriting. YIK discovers FA. YU and DAN devise to make SZE and CHI reconcile. However, CHI misses the chance due to FUNG. YU falls into the pond carelessly. DAN saves YU and takes the opportunity to express his love to YU. TIP finds her jade bracelet in FA`s room. FA denies. Meanwhile, FA is very sick. YIK tries to soothe her pain but FA withdraws frightfully.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: YIK discovered that FA suspects him. He then poisons FA to death. TIP tells CHI her grievance. They spend one night on the boat because it rains heavily. CHAN saw them. CHI carries out a forensic check for FA and thinks that nothing has gone wrong. SHING by chance finds out that FA was poisoned to death. CHI starts to investigate. YIK fears that they would find the truth, he then imputes the fault to TIP. CHI believes that TIP is innocent. LING points out that CHI still loves TIP. SZE ignores their comment. Nonetheless, SZE persuades CHI not to involve in this case. A burnt dead body was found in the forest. However, there is nobody missing in the village. CHI checks FA`s dead body carefully for a few days. He eventually gets some evidence favored TIP. YIK fears that CHI would unveil his secret……

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The judge dismisses CHI. SZE writes a letter to the criminal court in begging them to release CHI. However, the court requires CHI to find out the truth within one month. CHAN claims that he has examined YIK`s hand writing and CHING also claims that she had seen two identical YIK. CHI starts to believe that the YIK in person might be a false one. CHI tells SHING YIK`s motive in killing FA. CHI persuades SHING to check YIK`s real identity. However, YIK destroys all evidence before SHING took action. YIK beats CHI as TIP is pregnant. YIK claims that it is not his baby. CHI has difficulty to find the truth. CHAN and DAN also blame CHI. FUNG scolds them who do not trust friend. LUNG asks CHI not to see FUNG. CHI drinks to forget his troubles. FUNG wants to comforts CHI. CHI refuses FUNG. SZE sees that YIK is hurt while he is fighting with CHI. SZE then sends YIK some delicious food for consolation……

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: TIP attempts to kill herself. Fortunately, FUNG saves her in time. FUNG goes to see CHI in the funeral parlour. SZE invites YIK to go out so as to console him. CHI is enlightened and works hard to collect new evidence together with FUNG. SHING eventually confirms that YIK is not his son. YIK then kills SHING. CHI finds a rotten dead body and confirms that it is the real YIK. CHI make use of blood test to check YIK`s identity but is in vain.  YIK even puts CHI into the prison. YIK does not want to stay in this place. SZE recommends him to work in the capital. CHI eventually finds out why he failed in the blood test. YU encourages DAN to try again in the public examination. DAN is full of confidence with YU`s encouragement. TIP listens to YIK`s advice and accuses CHI on court. CHI is sentenced to death.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: All risk their lives to save CHI. CHI flees to the funeral parlour and discovers new evidence. However, CHI does not want to involve his friends into trouble, he returns to the prison to wait for the execution. He even starts to write his book `The Forensic Collection` in the prison. On the day of execution when the executioner is going to chop CHI`s head off, the sword breaks. CHIU appears ......... Could CHI wash off the disgrace? How will CHI handle the relationship among SZE, FUNG and him. Who will CHI choose?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: CHEE is appointed as the Chief Prosecutor after solving many cases. He brings his two pregnant wives to Hunan for his new post. On the way, he solves another murder case, but loses his wives in a fire. He is heartbroken and resigns to return to his home town. He is nearly drowned in a typhoon, but is saved by a detective, KIT. KIT brings him to work in a funeral parlour, which is run by LUNG.  CHU’s job is to apply make-up to corpses in the morgue. When she arrives with LUNG, they see CHEE cutting open a pregnant woman’s body with a chopper. Apparently, he is trying to remove the baby from the body. CHEE has a good friend, FUNG, whose mother can talk to dead people. CHEE asks if she can help find his wives, but she refuses because he doesn’t have enough money.  MRS NGAU, who saved CHEE before, is accused of murdering her husband. CHEE helps her to uncover the truth……

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview:
CHEE hides the fact that he has done an autopsy on NGAU’s body, and drops hints to LUNG about the cause of NGAU’s death.  CHU uses all her money to buy some swift nests. CHEE pushes her over when he pulls a boy from under some heavy weights. CHU’s swift nests are stolen.

CHEE decides to help CHU with her family business after learning that her mother is sick. When he goes to collect rent from a whorehouse, he sees a prostitute arguing with a man whom everyone thinks is possessed by a demon. FUNG and her mother ask LUNG to pretend to be possessed and make business by carrying out some rituals. FUNG subsequently annoys LUNG and he decides to tell everyone the truth. Later, LUNG and FUNG are both poisoned.  CHEE and CHU do make up for SIU’s body. CHEE reckons that SIU was pregnant and did not kill herself, but her parents do not believe him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: CHU tries to file a lawsuit over SIU’s death, but SIU’s father, WAN, stops her. KIT sees them arguing and WAN accuses CHU of blackmailing him with SIU’s death. CHU, CHEE and WAN end up in the courtroom. CHEE points out some suspicious evidence, but it is all overruled. Suddenly, CHEE gets a headache and cannot continue. CHEE asks to perform an autopsy in the courtroom and proves that SIU was pregnant and that she was murdered.  KIT and the other detectives look for SIU’s jade. They find that LUNG has taken SIU’s jade to a pawnshop, and a farmer is witness to LUNG and SIU’s relationship. Suddenly, LUNG is a suspect. LUNG says that he met FUNG the night when SIU was killed, but FUNG denies it. KIT finds a girl, PO, who proves that the farmer is lying and sets KIT free. PO’s mother, NAN, argues with CHU in the courtroom.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: LUNG tells CHEE about CHU and PO’s real relationship. CHU says that NAN set her mother up. FUNG performs a funeral service in WAN’s home. WAN’s wife asks her to save her. WAN says that she turned mad after their daughter died.  KIT asks CHEE to follow up SIU’s case and finds that WAN has taken SIU’s body away. CHEE forces him to return SIU’s body. CHEE notices a scar on SIU’s back and finds that SIU was not WAN’s real daughter. He finds a weapon which matches the scar on SIU’s back and catches the real murderer.  CHU is argumentativeand CHEE advises her to be nice to others. He encourages her with his own sad history. CHEE does not want CHU to get close to him, so he agrees to work as a coroner for Chief Detective KIN.  CHEE’s first job is to examine a female body with a missing leg. LUNG wants to work in the restaurant in order to get close to PO, but is rejected by NAN……

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: LUNG sees CHEE pass by while he is waiting for PO. PO and NAN are kidnapped by a masked man. Luckily, LUNG saves them, but CHEE meets the masked man.  Another girl is murdered by having her throat cut and her legs chopped off. CHEE believes that the killer is a cook, so he investigates all the cooks in town but finds nothing. LUNG finds some expensive herbs and a pair of red shoes among CHEE’s belongings and accuses him of being the murderer. Meanwhile, CHEE discovers who is the real murderer, but LUNG knocks him out when he is about to notify KIT. The murderer intends to kill CHEE and CHU.  LUNG boasts about how he caught the murderer. PO knows that many outsiders have died in their town and suggests building a crematorium. Some rich people in the village support her.  CHEE suddenly faints and is diagnosed with a blood clot in his brain……

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: MING encourages CHEE to live on. TUNG knows that MING was the royal physician, but he accidentally killed a general and became a fugitive. CHEE decides to help MING find out the real cause of death of the general. While he and LUNG are looking at the general’s body, TUNG and another general, HO, suddenly appear. CHEE is forced to reveal his true identity, but no one believes him. HO gives CHEE five days to send him a post-mortem report. CHEE wonders why TUNG stopped him from investigating the general’s death. KIN and KIT find a soldier who is taking the report to HO. They steal the report and send it to the court. MING is caught by TUNG and sent for execution when he is about to put needles through CHEE’s head. Luckily, the report arrives and CHEE writes a declaration to prove his real identity. A princess, HA, insists that CHEE is a fraud……

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: CHEE finds some poisoned needles in the general’s body and reveals the real killer. At the time of execution, HA carries the emperor’s gown to try to save the murderer, but the wind blows the gown again and the murderer is executed.  CHEE stays in the Pine Mount and works as a prosecutor. CHU has an argument with PO when she retrieves a piece of jade of CHEE’s wife. FUNG accidentally scars PO’s face. PO sues FUNG and she has to stay in prison for three days. CHEE tells CHU that does not intended to start another relationship and asks her not to treat him so nicely. PO asks LUNG to take her to see CHEE and returns his wife’s jade. CHEE asks PO to drop her lawsuit, but she requests 100 pieces of gold in compensation. FUNG tries to raise some money by selling her hair. CHEE and a rich man support her.  A servant maid jumps into a well and dies. CHEE finds out that the mistress had accused her of stealing her jewellery.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: KIT’s mother, LUI, wants to pull CHU and KIT together. A prostitute, MON saves FUNG from being bothered by some customers. KIT finds her nice. PO loses in a pageant. LUNG thinks that she is going to jump off a cliff and stops her.  PO suggests that LUNG should learn post-mortem technique from CHEE. LUNG asks CHEE to be his mentor in front of everyone. CHEE refuses at first, but he accepts the request on condition that LUNG performs a post-mortem alone next time someone dies.  LUNG is late for his first lesson and destroys some evidence at the scene. CHEE refuses to take him on as his student, after which PO rejects LUNG. PO meets a man, FOK. He is attracted by her pretty face.  LUI asks LUNG about CHU’s background. CHEE tells him all the good things about CHU. LUNG interrogates CHEE as to why he wants to pull KIT and CHU together.  FUNG wants to open a restaurant, but has no capital. MON agrees to help her……

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: LUNG is sorry that he cannot help PO. FUNG tries to cheer him up with her own experience. MON sees two little girls begging and believes that they are being used by kidnappers. When she reports it to the police, they laugh at her, but KIT believes her. Soon, they start seeing each other.  LUI and HANG try to pull KIT and CHU together, but they do not like the idea. When CHU finds out that KIT is seeing MON, she tries to cover it up for them. CHEE praises KIT in front of CHU. She pretends to agree.  CHU and MON follow the beggars and are caught by the kidnappers, whodemand a ransom. CHEE and KIT are very nervous. They try to trap them, but fail. FUNG is kidnapped too. LUNG kills the kidnappers by accident. MON and CHU are not found. CHEE tries hard to find clues on the kidnappers’ bodies and succeeds.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: A businessman goes missing. CHEE and the other investigators conclude that he is dead, but they find no body. LUNG thinks of a way to find the body. CHU and FUNG praise him in front of CHEE. In fact, CHEE lets LUNG find the body, so that they can become mentor and student.  FUNG tells CHU that she will match up with a man born in the year of dragon. She is delighted to find out that LUNG could be the one. LUNG accidentally misplaces some evidence. He is touched when CHU finds it for him.  CHEE asks LUNG and CHU to recreate the crime scene. LUNG feels something strange about CHU when he holds her up.  MON is bothered by her customer when she is shopping with KIT. KIT beats the man up. When KIN discovers their relationship, he objects to it. KIT insists on getting MON out from the whorehouse, but he is short of money. LUNG asks CHU out. She is shocked and thinks that he is joking.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: CHU mentions to FUNG that LUNG has asked her out and she will give him a chance. CHEE asks LUNG to put on thick clothes and jumps off a building to find out how a victim died. He is injured and CHU takes good care of him. Both CHEE and FUNG feel upset seeing them together.  KIT and MON want to run away, but KIN and MON’s employer catch them. MON gives up trying. CHU revises some post-mortem cases with LUNG. She asks him to save up for their future.  MON once lent some money to a man, SHING. He has now become rich and wants to free her from prostitution. Although she wants KIT to do it, she has no choice.  CHEE and CHU help a beggar. She gives them a butterfly knot each as a present. KIT falls ill from missing MON. LUI tells him that she is leaving with SHING. He runs to find her, but she tells him that she has never loved him. After KIT begs her to stay, she admits that she does not want to ruin him……

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview:
When MON testifies, KIN is nasty to her. He announces in the court that KIT is a suspect. Luckily, CHEE and LUNG are his alibis. TSUEN, who used to fight with SHING over MON, says that KIN wants to take revenge for his son.

FUNG wants to watch some shooting stars. LUNG asks CHU to go, but she refuses,so LUNG goes alone and meets FUNG. CHU scolds LUNG in public when she finds out that he has not finished his report because he went to see shooting stars.  LUNG has diarrhoea after eating FUNG’s congee. CHEE thinks that he is lying. In order to prove LUNG is not lying, FUNG eats the congee and ends up having diarrhoea as well.  MING tries to cure KIT’s blood-phobia and succeeds. CHU loses her butterfly knot and is terrified. CHEE gives his to LUNG. MING finds out that the swift nests that SHING has given to FUNG and CHU are fake and reports it to CHEE. LUNG suspects that SHING’s blood is mixed with animal blood……

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview:
MON is detained for further hearing. CHEE has proved that there is pig blood inside SHING’s body. FUNG mentions that a bucket of pig blood was missing behind a congee store on the night when SHING was killed. Everyone rushes to the back street to look for evidence. Unsurprisingly, there is a blood print made by a ring on the wall and CHEE finds the real murderer. The suspect runs when he sees the police are after him. KIT catches him bare-handed without fearing fresh blood on his body. After this case, the relationship between KIT and KIN seems improved.

LUNG goes to gamble on his rare day-off and forgets to cut his hair. FUNG hires someone to help him. When they are alone, LUNG has a special feeling for her. He asks FUNG whether he should be with CHU. FUNG asks him to leave. Later when LUNG returns her earrings, he pulls her into his arms.  CHU mentions to CHEE that she is babysitting LUNG more than dating him……

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview:
CHEE finds out that the lover of SHUN’s wife killed SHUN. LUNG sighs that SHUN and his wife do not match and he was killed because of that.  LUNG passes a dating slip to FUNG. However, both CHEE and CHU have seen the slip. When FUNG meets LUNG, she refuses to see him against for CHU’s sake. CHEE and CHU hear their conversation. CHU interrogates LUNG. He admits that he really likes FUNG. CHU tells FUNG that she is relieved that LUNG likes FUNG more.

A matchmaker points out that CHU has either to marry a retard or no one. CHU has an argument with her and moans that she does not need to get married.  LUNG passes the coroner test. Meanwhile, PO, who has already married, returns to the town and meets LUNG. She gives LUNG a safety charm and puzzles him.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: PO meets her sister-in-law, LEE, in a temple. LEE accuses of PO having adultery. PO pretends not to hear her. LUNG thanks PO for his career.  MO asks FOK to sponsor for the charity. FOK agrees to lend his house for the event. MO and PO go to check out the house and a worker dies at the same time. CHEE and LUNG examine the body, so LUNG has a chance to show off in front of PO.  There is a plague in the newest town. CHEE and MING are assigned to investigate. As soon as CHEE leaves the town, FOK dies. LUNG examines his body and reckons that FOK dies from a stroke. However, LEE insists that CHEE should examine FOK’s body again.  CHEE and MING meet a government official in during their trip. They all go to investigate the plague situation and eventually finds out its cause.  KIT finds out that PO’s servant maid has bought some Persian spices and suspects that something is going on.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview:
FUNG asks LUNG why he hides the fact that he has met PO. When CHEE is examining PO’s spices, CHU suddenly arrives. Under the influences of the spices, CHU asks CHEE why he refuses to admit falling in love with her. They then kiss each other. Meanwhile, KIT and MING arrive. MING says that they are meant to be together. CHEE uses his butterfly knot and jade pieces to test their love.  CHU sees PO hugging a man. PO suddenly loses her control and cuts CHU’s face. When CHEE wants to tell CHU about his love over her, she loses too much blood and faints. CHEE carries her to find MING. MING says that she will have a permanent scar. CHEE agrees to marry CHU, but she refuses his pity.

CHU suspects that PO is having adultery with FOK’s brother, ON. So he arranges FUNG and MO to test her. CHU and CHEE hike up mountains to find a special herb for curing CHU’s wound. CHEE slips and falls into a cave. CHU worries a lot for him……

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: PO proposes to split the family. LEE objects. Later, LEE finds out that she is pregnant. PO and ON feel that it is even more difficult to furnish their plot. PO meets LUNG for a drink. FUNG learns about that from HEUNG and feels jealous. Soon, LUNG is drunk. Meanwhile, LEE is burnt in a temple. FUNG passes the temple and sees a family shadow before the fire is put on. FUNG testifies seeing PO at the temple. However, LUNG insists that PO was drinking with him. ON is jealous seeing that PO and LUNG get intimate.  CHEE experiments PO’s spices with a dog and finds out some mixture could kill. He suspects that PO kills her husband. MON is molested and saved by PO. She invites him back home for dinner. She lights on the fragrant sticks that PO gave her. ON thinks that PO wants to kill him and MON together, so he goes to scold her and reveals their plot.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: LUNG is upset that KIT and CHEE are investigating PO behind him. He swears that he will never return to the town before he gets famous. NAM and CHU’s father, CHEUNG, ask HANG and CHU to save PO, but they refuse. PO is executed at last. HANG dreams of her every night and falls ill.  CHU and CHEE decide to get married. NAM is disturbed and curses their marriage. MING meets NAM when he goes to see HANG. NAM is muttering that she is going to give HANG a present. HANG’s shop is on fire. Two strangers move MING and HANG out from the shop. MING dies and HANG manages to give CHU a wedding present before she dies.  CHEE performs an autopsy to MING and HANG’s bodies and finds that MING had fractures and was tortured before death while HANG was not. It shows that MING was the target. CHU finds two coffins inside the shop and insists that NAM has killed MING and HANG. When CHU meets NAM, she wants to take her to see the police……

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: NAM dies and CHU is turned into a suspect. CHEE finds that NAM was rapped before she was killed. HIN and LUNG show up in the town. LUNG works under HIN now. When LUNG checks MING’s body, he finds that some tree rubber was put on MING to make it look like torture marks. CHEE exclaims that he has not put anything on MING to save CHU from being suspected. HIN asks LUNG to hand over the case.  CHU tells CHEE that she has met SHEUN. When they try to find her, she is nowhere. LUNG becomes very distant. He points out that KIT did not check for fight marks on CHU. He is also very cold to FUNG. He leads his subordinates to FUNG’s home and finds some of CHU’s clothing, which has blood from the day when she met SHEUN. CHU is locked up. CHEE suspects that there is someone planning everything. Later when he is investigating inside HANG’s shop, someone hurts his hand.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: CHEE tells HA that MING is dead. HA clarifies that she comes back for TUNG. CHEE meets LUNG and points out that all three people die only after he has left, so he has become the enemy’s pawn. LUNG is upset and accuse CHEE of hurting his confidence. MON sells cakes to raise money for orphans. KIN is moved by her kindness.  An old man burns some incence to scare the ghosts. He tells FUNG that he has seen NAM and CHU in the woods before NAM died. HIN and his subordinates get the news and meet up with KIN to find that old man. CHEE finds the old man’s body early that them. KIT finds CHU in the woods when he was investigating the case. He also finds her cutter there.  In the court, LUNG accuses CHEE of helping CHU in killing NAM and the old man. Luckily, HO can prove that CHEE was not at the scene when the murder was happening. CHU is turned into the only suspect.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: CHEE and KIT try to sneak into the morgue to check on MING’s body again, but is caught by LUNG. KIT is suspended. FUNG asks LUNG why he wants to convict CHU. He takes the chance to drug and rape her.  CHU refuses to confess no matter how much torture she is receiving. CHEE promise to quit his job if LUNG will save CHU. LUNG lies to HIN that he finds some new evidence after checking on MING’s body again and asks to see HA. LUNG has a deal with HA. If he gets to be the top prison warden, then CHEE will be framed and killed.  LUNG meets CHEE in the woods and they find some poisonous needles and bamboo cases. In the court, LUNG lies about that some of CHEE’s fingerprints are found on the weapon which was used to kill the old man. CHEE has expected LUNG to do this to him. LUNG threatens FUNG to team up with him in order to kill her and her mother alive.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview:
FUNG tells CHEE that the Duke is going to meet him at a pier. Meanwhile, a black suited man takes CHU from the prison to the pier and pushes a sword into CHEE’s hand. HIN arrives and charges of CHEE killing the prison warden. In the court, CHEE asks FUNG to prove that the Duke wants to see him. However, FUNG denies it. Both CHEE and CHU are disappointed with FUNG’s lie. They are eventually given death sentences.  CHU and CHU wants to get married in the prison, but HA stopped them. The Duke and HO try to save them, but fail, on the day of execution. When LUNG passes HA CHEE’s head, both HA and LUNG are poisoned. Meanwhile, CHEE and CHU appear.

HA suddenly tries to stab CHEE with a knife. CHU gets in front of CHEE to save him. CHEE thinks that everyone he loves is cursed and leaves immediately. Does CHEE really have to live a lonely life?
